title: Practice 9: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: The singer suddenly switches into falsetto.
exercises.why: **переходить → переходит** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: У неё ___ (иметься) крупные капиталовложения в автомобильной промышленности.
exercises.prompt: She has large interests in the car industry.
exercises.why: **иметься → имеются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The Bridge of No Return separates the two Koreas.
exercises.why: **разделять → разделяет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Spring is late this year.
exercises.why: **запаздывать → запаздывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He has an air of respectability about him.
exercises.why: **держаться → держится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I have pain in my lower back.
exercises.why: **болеть → болит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Milk goes bad quickly in hot weather.
exercises.why: **скисать → скисает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I feel in my bones that the party will be a great success.
exercises.why: **чуять → чую** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Wisdom gives us power.
exercises.why: **давать → даёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: По этой дороге ___ (ездить) всё реже, и она постепенно зарастает травой.
exercises.prompt: This road is driven on less and less, and it is slowly becoming overgrown with grass.
exercises.why: **ездить → ездят** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The station is under repair.
exercises.why: **ремонтироваться → ремонтируется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: У меня на завтра ничего не ___ (намечаться).
exercises.prompt: I have no plans for tomorrow.
exercises.why: **намечаться → намечается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Officers of the navy wear white uniforms.
exercises.why: **носить → носят** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Commercial use of these materials is prohibited.
exercises.why: **воспрещаться → воспрещается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tatoeba is slow today.
exercises.why: **тормозить → тормозит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Are you still afraid?
exercises.why: **бояться → боишься** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: A tight belt interferes with circulation of the blood.
exercises.why: **препятствовать → препятствует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: A space is missing before the colon.
exercises.why: **хватать → хватает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: People who do bodybuilding are called bodybuilders.
exercises.why: **заниматься → занимаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Его критика тайцев совсем не ___ (совпадать) с моими знаниями о них.
exercises.prompt: His criticism of the Thai people doesn't jibe at all with my experience of them.
exercises.why: **совпадать → совпадает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
